claims.text: The preserved source asks about continuous subarrays whose sum is a multiple of K, explicitly mentions prefix sum and hash optimization, and records LeetCode 523/974 together without preserving one exact output contract; the candidate therefore implements and distinguishes both existence and counting variants.

Under the explicit k!=0 candidate contract, equal normalized prefix remainders characterize subarrays whose sum is divisible by k; frequency state counts all pairs while earliest-index state supports the length-at-least-two existence variant.
The deterministic fixture checks counting and existence variants, all-zero combinations, negative elements, negative k, minimum-length behavior, and explicit k=0/null boundaries.
